description: BLS12-381 compliance proof vector for the ADR 0002 gas benchmark
status: DEV ONLY — single-party trusted setup (snarkjs zkey contribute, entropy discarded). Never use for production.
circuit: circuits/compliance.circom compiled with circom v2.2.2 --prime bls12381 (30164 constraints)
setup: snarkjs powersoftau new bls12381 15 + contribute + prepare phase2; groth16 setup + 1 contribution
input_regeneration: python scripts/make_bls_input.py — recomputes Poseidon-derived values from tests/vectors/compliance/input.json for the BLS12-381 scalar field. NOTE: circomlib's Poseidon circuit uses the optimized (Neptune) algorithm with constants derived mod BN254; over BLS12-381 the circuit therefore computes a NON-STANDARD hash variant (opt algorithm, BN254-derived constants mod BLS_r). This script mirrors the compiled circuit exactly (verified against wasm execution). A production BLS migration must regenerate curve-correct Poseidon parameters.

measured_gas.method: ethers estimateGas on Hardhat Prague EVM, 2026-07-23
